summary: Frontend-only test of count-up, hover colours, reduced motion and regressions. Passed: 7 .count[data-count] spans on home (Timeline 3,000+/18, AIR 18; Museum ex1/ex3 3,000+, ex3 99.8%; Achievements AIR 18). Each one counts up from 0 when it scrolls into view (e.g. 885+ → 2,973+ → 3,000+; AIR 3 → 18) and ends on exactly the original text. Surrounding words are unchanged ('~99.8% fewer records…', 'AIR 18 in CUET PG DU MCA'), and 'React 18' in Skills is correctly left alone. At 1920x900, museum exhibit 3's 99.8% starts counting (3.9% → 99.8%) only once it is on screen (x=1482, y=849). Story pages 3 (99.8%) and 4 (18) count up on scroll; stories 1 and 2 contain no matching numbers. Hover: hero pills (Resume/LinkedIn/GitHub/Email) and museum 'Read the full story' go from rgb(240,215,255) to rgb(232,198,255) with transform none, box-shadow none, and the arrow does not move. Museum .bezel goes from rgb(228,228,208) to slightly darker (~rgb(214,214,196)) with an identity transform and no shadow. Reduced motion: no intro, hero visible, halftone drawn (61,738 px), no .pin-spacer, no Lenis, roller reads 2025 immediately, all 21 [data-reveal] at opacity 1, numbers show final text, museum cards wrap in a grid, story 3 shows 99.8% straight away. Regression: intro plus Skip works, theme cord toggles the dark class on and off, timeline is pinned with rolling years (2025 → 2023 → 2020), museum horizontal pin works and progress reaches 04/04, mobile 390x844 has no pinning, a column track and no horizontal overflow. There were no console errors on valid routes. One bug: an invalid story id crashes the page.

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime crash 'Cannot read properties of null (reading querySelectorAll)'. useCountUp runs its effect while the page renders <Navigate> instead of <main>, so ref.current is null. The Emergent error overlay appears instead of the redirect to home.

issues: The progress indicator '01 / 04' and its empty bar still show even though there is no horizontal scroll, so they never update. Hide .museum-progress under prefers-reduced-motion.

action_items: Fix the Story.jsx crash on invalid ids. Either guard useCountUp (if (!ref.current) return;) or do the story lookup and return <Navigate> before calling the hook's consumer, e.g. split it into a <StoryContent> component.
Optional: hide .museum-progress when prefers-reduced-motion is set.
critical_code_review_comments: useCountUp: no null guard on ref.current, which is the root cause of the crash above.

useCountUp/useReveal in Story.jsx depend on [ref] only. If you navigate from one story to another without a remount (same route component, id changes), the new story's .count spans are never observed. Add id to the deps or key the page by id.
useCountUp cleanup writes el.textContent on React-managed nodes. This is fine for static text but fragile if the content becomes dynamic.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use page.emulate_media(reduced_motion='reduce') and reload to test reduced motion. Use a MutationObserver on .count spans to log count-up frames. To get the museum pin start, take the .pin-spacer that is the closest ancestor of [data-testid=museum-section] and read its top. At 1920 wide, exhibit 3 is already partly in view when the pin starts. /museum-of-failures/99 crashes; retest after the fix.
